kebab_example: aliyun cas create-sub-ca-certificate --common-name Aliyun --organization-unit Security --organization Alibaba --locality Hangzhou --state Zhejiang --algorithm RSA_2048 --years 5 --api-version 2020-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSubCACertificate

parameters.help_en:

根CA证书的唯一识别码。

parameters.name: parent_identifier

parameters.help_zh: 组织机构的通用名称或简称。支持使用中文、英文字符等
parameters.name: common_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the department or branch under the organization. Chinese and English characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 组织机构下部门或分支的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等
parameters.name: organization_unit

parameters.help_en: The name of the organization associated with the subordinate CA certificate (corresponding to your enterprise or entity). Chinese and English characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 子CA证书关联的组织机构（对应您的企业或单位）的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等
parameters.name: organization

parameters.help_en: The name of the city where the organization is located. Chinese and English characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 组织机构所在城市的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等
parameters.name: locality

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The name of the province, municipality, or autonomous region where the organization is located. Chinese and English characters are supported.</props>
<props="intl">The name of the province or state where the organization is located. Chinese and English characters are supported.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等。</props>
<props="intl">组织机构所在省份或州的名称。支持使用中文、英文字符等。</props>
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The code of the country or region where the organization is located, represented by a two-letter or three-letter uppercase abbreviation. For example, CN represents China, and US represents the United States.

For the codes of different countries, see the International codes section in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html
parameters.help_zh:
组织机构所在国家或地区的代码，使用两位或三位大写英文字母缩写表示。例如，CN表示中国，US表示美国。

关于不同国家的代码，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html中的**国际代号**章节
parameters.name: country_code

parameters.help_en:
The key algorithm type of the subordinate CA certificate. The key algorithm is represented in the `<encryption algorithm>_<key length>` format. Valid values:
RSA_1024: The corresponding signature algorithm is Sha256WithRSA.
RSA_2048: The corresponding signature algorithm is Sha256WithRSA.
RSA_4096: The corresponding signature algorithm is Sha256WithRSA.
ECC_256: The corresponding signature algorithm is Sha256WithECDSA.
SM2_256: The corresponding signature algorithm is SM3WithSM2.


The encryption algorithm of the subordinate CA certificate must be the same as that of the root CA certificate, but the key length can be different. Example: If the key algorithm of the root CA certificate is RSA_2048, the key algorithm of the subordinate CA certificate must be RSA_1024, RSA_2048, or RSA_4096.

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465954.html to query the key algorithm of the root CA certificate
parameters.help_zh:
子CA证书的密钥算法类型。密钥算法使用`<加密算法>_<密钥长度>`格式表示。取值：
RSA_1024：对应签名算法为Sha256WithRSA。
RSA_2048：对应签名算法为Sha256WithRSA。
RSA_4096：对应签名算法为Sha256WithRSA。
ECC_256：对应签名算法为Sha256WithECDSA。
SM2_256：对应签名算法为SM3WithSM2。


子CA证书的加密算法必须与根CA证书一致，密钥长度可以不一致。示例：根CA证书的密钥算法为RSA_2048，则子CA证书的密钥算法必须是RSA_1024、RSA_2048、RSA_4096。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465954.html查询根CA证书的密钥算法
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the subordinate CA certificate. Unit: years.

Set this value to 5 to 10 years.

The validity period of the subordinate CA certificate cannot exceed that of the root CA certificate. You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465954.html to query the validity period of the root CA certificate
parameters.help_zh:
子CA证书的有效期，单位：年。

建议设置为5~10年。


子CA证书的有效期不能超过根CA证书的有效期。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465954.html查询根CA证书的有效期
parameters.name: years

parameters.help_en: The path length constraint of the certificate. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 证书路径长度限制，默认0
parameters.name: path_len_constraint

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the CRL service. Valid values:

false: Disabled.
true: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用CRL服务

false - 否
true - 是
parameters.name: enable_crl

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the CRL. Valid values: 1 to 365. Unit: days
parameters.name: crl_day

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The parameter value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum validity period of certificates issued by the CA, specified by the certMaxTime of the CA. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 签发证书的最长时间由CA的certMaxTime指定。单位：天
parameters.name: cert_max_time
